facts.title: Circuit-wide court reporting
facts.summary: AO2026-04 applies across four counties to reporting at public expense; it does not promise automatic recording of all commercial cases. Official transcripts use approved reporting/transcription providers; preparation on request/order. Electronic Court Reporting Office:306Courthouse Addition,218SouthSecondStreet,FortPierce34950. Audio-request form available through circuit site; deposit generally50% with stated exceptions. Attorneys should protect confidential conversations around recording equipment. Order revokes2001-02,2001-19,2016-01.
